theorems.name: Submission.bounded_set_closedBall_cover_card_mul_pow_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Set (Rn n)), Bornology.IsBounded K → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r ≤ 1 → ∃ s : Finset (Rn n), (↑s : Set (Rn n)) ⊆ K ∧ K ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ s, closedBall x r ∧ (s.card : ℝ) * r ^ n ≤ C
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
